description: Search people by keywords and filters, read FRESH at request time. Returns the first 1,000 results per query; page with `start`. Costs $0.0012 per live read. Give `keywords` or at least one filter. A member the network will not name to the reading account comes back with `hidden: true`, `name`, `profile_ref` and `profile_url` null and a `person_ref` (people_profile takes it); coverage does not count those withheld fields. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged. Limits: no daily cap once the account has topped up; one per-account limit a minute sized to our read pool's live capacity (pricing_get people_reads.rate_limit_per_minute; over it 429 people_read_rate_limit with Retry-After, free); an account on the free signup balance only gets 100 of these reads a day (429 daily_read_limit until 00:00 UTC, free) until its first top-up.

filters.description: Named filters: network, current_company, past_company, location, industry, school, profile_language, connection_of, service_category, first_name, last_name, title, company, school_name.

start.description: Zero-based offset into the first 1,000 results.

name: people_search
title: Search People
